title: SamplerInstrument
description: Sampler instrument payloads: sampler_load_instrument / sampler_list_instruments results, and the project.json v2 instrument reference. The instrument CONTENT is an .sfz file restricted to the AURA SFZ SUBSET v1 — the normative opcode table lives in src-tauri/src/audio/sampler.rs and docs/PHASE2-PLAN.md; both the sampler (zone D loader) and the Stable Audio instrument-builder sidecar (zone D generator) are bound by it. Emitter contract — no additionalProperties:false (D-06).

instrumentInfo.title: InstrumentInfo
instrumentInfo.description: Wire summary of a loaded instrument (Rust: audio::sampler::InstrumentInfo).

projectRef.title: ProjectInstrumentRef
projectRef.description: project.json v2 `instruments[]` entry. Instruments used by a project are copied into `<project>/instruments/<id>/` so projects stay portable; sfzRef is relative to the .aura dir.
